claims.text: Captain Smit Machchhar was attacked inside the cockpit by his co-pilot on a Flydubai flight traveling from Dubai to Tel Aviv.
The Flydubai cockpit attack suspect was identified as Omani citizen Hamam Alhamami.
Hamam Alhamami was previously barred from flying in Oman over concerns regarding his alleged extremist views.
Hamam Alhamami was removed from a training role at Oman Air last year due to concerns about his radical views.
Leaflets and publications from 'Free Palestine' groups were found among Hamam Alhamami's belongings.
During the confrontation aboard the Flydubai flight, the aircraft dropped approximately 16,000 feet within two minutes.
Hamam Alhamami was transferred from Saudi Arabia to the UAE, where he faces a terrorism investigation.
Speaking to Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi from an Abu Dhabi hospital, pilot Smit Machchhar said, 'I was being hit even then, but I just opened the door and everyone came in.'
Smit Machchhar has 17 years of aviation experience, including 11 years as a captain.
UAE presidential adviser Anwar Gargash called the Flydubai cockpit incident a 'terrorist act'.
US President Donald Trump warned that Iran would be 'hit very hard' if found to be linked to the Flydubai attack.
Flightradar24 data showed the Flydubai aircraft plunged 16,625 feet in just over 30 seconds over Saudi Arabia.
Flydubai CEO Ghaith Al Ghaith stated that authorities are conducting an official investigation into the safety incident.
Passenger Tali Manes alerted a flight attendant after hearing heavy blows against the cockpit door during the Flydubai flight.
Passengers and off-duty pilots overpowered the co-pilot and safely landed the aircraft 90 minutes later in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
Congress MP Rahul Gandhi posted on X that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar 'will go. Because a lathi can stop a crowd, but not a question.'
More than 700 demonstrators were detained by police in New Delhi during protests demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
AAP leaders Atishi and Saurabh Bhardwaj were detained by police during protests in Delhi against the election chief.
The Cockroach Janta Party held a mass demonstration at Shivaji Park in Mumbai demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's removal grew after reports that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi objected to decisions taken by the Election Commission.
DMK chief MK Stalin criticized Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay over his silence regarding the Special Intensive Revision exercise and the election commissioner controversy.
Tens of millions of citizens were deleted from India's electoral register during the Special Intensive Revision exercise overseen by Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Authorities in New Delhi deployed thousands of police officers, closed 12 metro stations, and imposed an internet shutdown to restrict protests at Jantar Mantar.
The Congress party replaced Ajay Rai with Aradhana 'Mona' Mishra as the president of the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee.
Congress appointed Saharanpur MP Imran Masood as working president of its Uttar Pradesh unit.
Congress named Rajendra Pal Gautam, a Dalit leader, as the party's state in-charge for Uttar Pradesh.
Aradhana Misra Mona is a three-time MLA representing the Rampur Khas Assembly seat in Pratapgarh district and the daughter of senior leader Pramod Tiwari.
Chaudhary Virendra Singh was appointed as the Leader of the Congress Legislature Party in the Uttar Pradesh Assembly.
Former Indian hockey captain and MLA Pargat Singh was appointed as the new president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee.
Amarinder Singh Raja Warring resigned as president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee after meeting Rahul Gandhi.
Sachin Pilot recently replaced Bhupesh Baghel as the AICC in-charge of Punjab.
Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge approved the appointments of Devinder Nishad and Alok Prasad as senior vice presidents of the Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee.
